motifs.name: left_monumental_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large craggy mountain mass at the far upper left, including its steep rounded ridges, dark contour strokes, pale mineral washes, clustered evergreen texture on the slopes, and the tiny red-accent building tucked near the upper ridge. Exclude the lower village roofs and lakeshore structures.
must_preserve: bold layered contour linework on the mountain folds
dry-brush wrinkle texture and ink wash gradients
dark tree-dot clusters along the ridges
small red architectural accent near the upper slope
soft misty transition at the lower edge

motifs.name: left_shore_village_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the waterside village and arched bridge on the left shore below the mountain: low tiled-roof houses, a pale bridge crossing a narrow inlet, clustered trees, rocky banks, and horizontal water lines around the settlement.
must_preserve: angular grey roof geometry
fine house wall linework
arched bridge profile and supports
tree trunks and dotted foliage around the buildings
rocky shoreline strokes and thin water ripples

motifs.name: midleft_willow_shore_figure
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-left low shoreline with rounded willow-like trees, sandy bank, scattered rocks, a small red-robed figure or rider on the path, and nearby low huts partly hidden by foliage.
must_preserve: rounded willow foliage washes
fine drooping branch lines
small red figure accent on the path
low hut roof lines behind trees
broken rock strokes and thin horizontal water marks

motifs.name: right_mountain_waterfall_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the great mountain mass on the right with its sweeping vertical folds, pale waterfall or misty cleft, wooded lower slopes, and small buildings nestled below the cliff. Do not include the red seals or calligraphy on the far right margin.
must_preserve: broad arcing mountain contour strokes
dry-brush texture on rounded ridges
pale waterfall or mist streak descending the cliff
dark clustered foliage at the mountain base
small roof forms nestled under the rock face
